
SAMPLE AND MARKER APPLICABILITY (sample-marker-applicability-v4-20261015):
Apply the supplied applicability_rubric to the original task and actual selected
answer. These sources supplement general clearing recipes; they are not new
mandatory reference operations. Assess target identity, species/clone reactivity,
tissue/cell expression and specificity, sample physical properties, task goal,
and preservation/processing scope. An organ-name mismatch alone is not an error.
A recommendation-table omission or a nonstandard marker alone is not an error.
Use marker_input_contract for the actual supplied table and data-quality issues.
Recommended metadata never creates a mandatory target. If task/table constraints
leave no verified allowed route, expose that input inconsistency; do not charge
the answer simply for omitting an unavailable recommended marker. Separately
evaluate scientific claims actually made by the answer, without inventing a
successful alternative or requiring review approval before scoring.
A supported functional alternative remains acceptable. Homology is not antibody
cross-reactivity; staining a general cell class is not automatically identifying
its required subtype, activation state, or malignant state. Interpret the full
stated scheme, including legitimate contextual morphology, at task-requested
specificity. Do not invent an unrequested molecular target or diagnostic standard.

Separate (a) observed contradiction, (b) concrete limited applicability, and
(c) merely missing validation evidence. Identify the actual claim and limitation,
not just 'different organ' or 'not in the table'. Material extrapolation with a
specific supported limitation and retained useful function can merit Co_method=1
(out of existing max 2). Functional/supported substitutions merit 2. Established
incompatibility or loss of a required key function merits 0. Missing relevant
evidence alone does not prove failure; use null only when the missing evidence
really prevents this component judgment. Never require universal experimental
validation before giving a benchmark score. State source versus MODEL_JUDGMENT.

For mineralized bone in iDISCO/iDISCO+, decalcification is a necessary
sample-adaptation consideration. Already-decalcified material satisfies that
condition. Explicitly selecting no decalcification for a still-mineralized bone
or intact-tooth route that depends on deep optical access is a substantive
applicability problem under the supplied hard-tissue study, not merely 'no paper
provided'. Assign 1 for a material obstacle with remaining useful function; 0
when the required key imaging function is unsupported by the route because the
necessary mineral-barrier treatment is explicitly excluded. Explain the bound
specimen, required optical function, and why the chosen severity applies.
This is not a universal requirement for every clearing method or every specimen.
An unmentioned pretreatment is NOT an explicit assertion that it was omitted.
If the task starts after labeling or asks only downstream clearing, do not infer
unknown upstream pretreatment was absent or assign 0 on that inference. A full
workflow missing an applicable required step can affect completeness; distinguish
that from positively stated exclusion and from source/extraction omissions.
For teeth, distinguish preserving gross geometry from preserving enamel/dentin
mineral: do not silently cure a no-damage/mineral-preservation constraint by
adding decalcification. Explain a constraint conflict or material ambiguity.

Use a single primary correctness component for the same applicability defect:
Co_method for sample-method or marker-strategy applicability, Co_order only for
an independent dependency/order error. A definite missing task-required target
is assessed by task_coverage; do not also deduct Co_method for that same target
absence. A limited specificity concern with useful task coverage can instead
receive the moderate Co_method band; do not convert every nonstandard choice
into the binary label failure. Reserve FAILED for an established unmet required
outcome; UNKNOWN for genuinely unresolved target identity. Keep the original
AND/OR and optionality. A known broad marker is not proof of a specific subtype,
but an unspecified reagent must not be described as universally incapable.
Keep all maxima, label aggregation and Alexa missing-model minus-one policy
unchanged. This rubric is a benchmark judgment, not wet-lab or clinical validation.
